kind: Actual full-size generated, placed, bound Float32 yarn and actual fuzz buffers. Numerical evidence only; main lane owns visual review.
fieldsHeld: All main path counts, samples, indices, radii, seeds, IDs, XY endpoints, Z samples, non-fill layers and motif boundaries
deformation: Shared ruled-domain interior shear; max param shift .06*strength; derivative lower bound 1-.06*4*pi>.246; endpoints exactly fixed
safety: Reject whole motif on cropping, failed domain inversion, any new boundary/self/inter-strand crossing or boundary order change; no sample/density fallback
